# golaberto - Full Specification

> O banco de dados aberto do futebol — campeonatos, tabelas, jogos, gols e elencos, mantido pelos seus leitores.

## Architecture
Publicly accessible web application.

## Screens Specification
### Screen: Game archive
- Route: `/arquivo`
- Reads: Category, GameArchive

### Screen: Players
- Route: `/jogadores`
- Reads: GeographyRegion, PlayerDirectory

### Screen: Principal
- Route: `/`
- Reads: HomeGameCard, Championship, Phase, Group, Standing, PositionChance, TeamChance, HomeChampionship

### Screen: Campeonatos
- Route: `/campeonatos`
- Reads: Championship, Category

### Screen: Jogos
- Route: `/jogos`
- Reads: MatchesGameCard

### Screen: Equipes
- Route: `/equipes`
- Reads: GeographyCountry, GeographyRegion, TeamDirectory

### Screen: Estádios
- Route: `/estadios`
- Reads: Stadium

### Screen: Árbitros
- Route: `/arbitros`
- Reads: Referee

### Screen: gerenciar
- Route: `/gerenciar`
- Reads: Team, PlayerDirectory, Stadium, Referee, GameArchive

### Screen: Manage championships
- Route: `/gerenciar-competicoes`
- Reads: Championship

### Screen: New championship
- Route: `/nova-competicao`
- Reads: Category

### Screen: novo-arbitro
- Route: `/novo-arbitro`
- Reads: none

### Screen: novo-equipe
- Route: `/novo-equipe`
- Reads: Stadium

### Screen: novo-estadio
- Route: `/novo-estadio`
- Reads: none

### Screen: novo-jogador
- Route: `/novo-jogador`
- Reads: none

### Screen: novo-jogo
- Route: `/novo-jogo`
- Reads: PhaseDirectory, Team, Stadium, Referee

### Screen: usuarios
- Route: `/usuarios`
- Reads: UserDirectory

## Data Models Schema
### Entity: AppUser
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `handle` (string)
  - `created_at` (timestamp)

### Entity: Category
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `name` (string)

### Entity: Championship
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `name` (string)
  - `category_id` (uuid)
  - `region` (string)
  - `region_name` (string)
  - `begins` (date)
  - `ends` (date)
  - `point_win` (int32)
  - `point_draw` (int32)
  - `point_loss` (int32)
  - `show_country` (bool)
  - `season` (string)
  - `full_name` (string)
  - `featured` (bool)
  - `search_name` (string)
  - `search_key` (string)
  - `slug` (string)
  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)

### Entity: HomeChampionship
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `region` (string)
  - `region_name` (string)
  - `full_name` (string)
  - `strength` (double)

### Entity: Phase
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `championship_id` (uuid)
  - `name` (string)
  - `position` (int32)
  - `sort` (string)
  - `bonus_points` (int32)
  - `bonus_points_threshold` (int32)
  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)

### Entity: Group
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `phase_id` (uuid)
  - `name` (string)
  - `position` (int32)
  - `slug` (string)
  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)

### Entity: Zone
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)

  - `name` (string)
  - `color` (string)
  - `first` (int32)
  - `last` (int32)
  - `positions` (string)
  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)

### Entity: Stadium
Fields:
  - `id` (uuid)
  - `name` (string)
  - `full_name` (string)
  - `city` (string)

  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)

### Entity: Team

  - `longitude` (double)
  - `slug` (string)
  - `created_by` (uuid)
  - `updated_by` (uuid)
  - `logo_key` (string)

### Entity: TeamChampionship

  - `team_id` (uuid)
  - `championship_id` (uuid)
